pass_gates.rule: Use HMLR Index Polygons INSPIRE dataset for registered freehold indicative extents; do not substitute Local Land Charges INSPIRE.
Current Index Polygons dataset publication date is 2026-07-05.
Index Polygons files refresh on the first Sunday of each month.
London Borough of Barnet is listed in the current Index Polygons download set.
London Borough of Enfield is listed in the current Index Polygons download set.
Index Polygons provide indicative extent/position, not exact legal boundary proof.
Local Land Charges INSPIRE is a distinct dataset published 2026-07-06 with a different monthly cadence; it is not a replacement parcel-boundary source.
EA LIDAR Composite DTM 1m is the primary terrain source for the revision-14 numeric chain.
EA LIDAR Composite DTM 1m reports approximately 99 percent England coverage at 1m spatial resolution.
EA LIDAR vertical accuracy is plus/minus 15cm RMSE.
EA LIDAR Composite DTM 1m metadata declares EPSG:27700 horizontal CRS.
EA composite uses newest/best-resolution contributing surveys and metadata indexes must be retained for survey lineage.
EA publishes a persistent LIDAR Composite DTM 1m WCS endpoint; GetCapabilities is the required service-discovery path.
OS Terrain 50 is a lower-resolution broad-area DTM and remains an independent crosscheck, not the parcel range source.
OS Terrain 50 grid is supplied as 10km by 10km tiles with regular 50m spacing.
OS Terrain 50 ASCII grid height is calculated at the centre of each 50m pixel.
OS Terrain 50 10km grid contains 200 pixels per row and 200 rows.
OS Terrain 50 grid heights are stored to nearest 0.1m and per-tile metadata includes flying-date information.
